text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright isn't feeling well, so I take her to the infirmary to get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I apologize for the inconvenience, Trainer, but I shall be focusing on resting for the time being.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh? This is… the Mejiro estate?

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text: Eiiight… Niiine… Ten! Ready or not, Bright, here I come!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Goodness! I'd forgotten, but I'm in the middle of a game of hide-and-seek with Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Where shall I hide today? I must remain veeery sneaky as I conceal myself…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Heehee! Ryan would never expect me to tuck myself away inside the storage shed, now would she? ♪

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright? Where'd you go?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Over heeere… ♪ Come and find meee… ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Teeheehee! Now to act surprised when Ryan opens this door… ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: …Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: …Ryan? Have you gotten lost again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: …I'm here, Big Sis… So, just like you always do—

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah! Bright! Found ya!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: …! Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text: B-Bright?! What's wrong? …Heh. Did you get spooked in the dark?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: No, no. I'm not afraid at all, not even in the dark. After all—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Wherever I happen to be, my wonderful big sister will come and find me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: …Hehe! What a delightful memory. Now, though, I must ensure that this week's training is as thorough as always.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm guessing that bout of rest did the trick because Mejiro Bright is fighting fit again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: …Ryan? Have you gotten lost again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: This game of hide-and-seek won't end until you've found meee. ♪ Not to mention…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: …I'm becoming quite lonely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: …Ah. So it was a dream…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: But of course it was. The real Mejiro Ryan would come and find me no matter what…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like a bad dream kept Mejiro Bright from getting much rest at all.
